title: QorCap bundle.json (fields QorTime reads; extra fields allowed)

challenge_rule.description: Official challenge measurement. Absent or 1: segment_ranges clock, pause 0..600 ms, dark-menu caps full<=16 and lower<=8. 2: fragment PTS clock, pause 0..2500 ms, latencies within ±300 ms of their median, dark-menu caps full<=26 and lower<=16. The bright-text fraction stays 0.5%..5% on both.
